title: Always Tomorrow
lyrics_plain:
I've been alone inside myself
for far to long.
Never really wanted it that way
but I let it happen.
If I could do it all again
my life would be
Infinetily better than before
I wouldn't waste a moment.
Make time for laughing with my friends.
Make love, make music, make amends.
Try to make a difference try to love
to understand.
Instead if just giving up
I'd use the power at my command.
'Cause there's always tomorrow
to start over again.
Things will never stay the same
the only one sure thing is change.
That's why there's always tomorrow.
I guess it took a little time,
for me to see.
The reason I was born into this world
and what I'd have to go through.
For I've finally realized
that I could be.
Infinitely better than before
definitely stronger.
I'll face whatever comes my way.
Savor each moment of the day.
Love as many people as I can
along the way.
Help someone who's giving up
if it's just raise my eyes and pray.
Cause there's always tomorrow
to start over again.
Things will never stay the same
the only one sure thing is change.
That's why there's always tomorrow.
Before the last setting sun.
And everything your heart has longed for.
Has yet to be one.
Yet there's always tomorrow
though people come and they go.
But if you brought some love into there lives.
Then you've got something to show.
Cause there's always tomorrow
to start over again.
Things will never stay the same
the only one sure thing is change.
That's why there's always tomorrow.
